response.original_title: The River We Dare To Look At
response.overview: After an accidental escape from home and marriage, Nara returns alone to the city where she once studied abroad, in search of a long-lost friend. Along the way, memories of a river and a choice repeatedly emerge in her mind, as the journey gradually becomes one of self-rediscovery and revisiting the moment that seemingly shaped the course of her life.
response.title: The River We Dare To Look At
